recording.riwaya: Hafs an Asim: MP3Quran labels Ali Jaber's complete recording (reciter 76, moshaf 76) "حفص عن عاصم - مرتل"; whether EveryAyah's files are cut from that performance is checked per surah (per-ayah README, "Identity"). EveryAyah lists the set without a riwaya prefix. Not confirmed by ear.
recording.requestedBy: owner, 2026-10-23 (Phase 3: development preview with risk-based review)

rights.evidence: EveryAyah publishes no licence or terms for its audio (checked 2026-10-23); MP3Quran's permission is site-wide and covers its own files, not EveryAyah's. No permission for use in an app is recorded: development preview only.

identity.rule: every 3 s chunk of the ayah file found in order in the reference surah (score >= 0.45)

rule: LOW risk only when every automated check passes clearly; anything missing, damaged, unusual, contradictory or uncertain is HIGH risk. LOW risk is not a verification: no automated check found a reason to listen. Only a person decides by ear.

durationBins.method: rolling window of the 300 ayahs nearest in letter count, surah pace removed, z by the window MAD (floor 0.03 log)

notPlayed.identified: the Basmala (score 0.634 vs 0.318 for the isti'adha; transcription "bsmnlhalrwhmanalrhym")
notPlayed.note: At-Tawbah opens without the Basmala: this file is not played by the app.
